component.name: nurb
component.summary: Agentic CAD app that builds parts from plain-language descriptions

description.p: nurb is an agentic CAD application: describe the part you want in plain language and it designs it for you, iterating on your feedback until the model matches what you have in mind.

A live viewer shows the model as it takes shape, with built-in printability checks so problems are caught before they reach the printer. Finished designs can be exported as 3MF for slicing and 3D printing.
